meta.title: OBJECTSCADA — web SCADA for monitoring and control of industrial processes
meta.description: OBJECTSCADA is a web SCADA system: mimic diagrams, alarms, trends, recipes and batches in the browser. Connects to Siemens S7, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT and EtherNet/IP. Installs on-premise and works offline.

hero.h1: Monitor and control your process from any browser
hero.sub: OBJECTSCADA connects to your PLCs, shows the plant on live mimic diagrams and keeps alarms, trends, recipes and batches in one system. It runs on your own server and needs no internet.
hero.shotAlt: OBJECTSCADA mimic diagram of a pasteurization line

features.h2: One system from the PLC to the operator
features.intro: Everything an operator, a process engineer and an automation engineer need — without add-on modules and separate licences.

items.title: Works in the browser
items.description: Operator stations on any PC, panel or tablet in the plant network. Nothing to install on workstations — one server serves the whole site.

items.title: Mimic diagram editor
items.description: Drag devices, pipes, tanks and production lines onto the canvas. Popups, buttons, images and live values are configured without code.

items.title: Alarms that reach people
items.description: Four severity levels, acknowledgement, a siren that sounds until someone responds, and email or SMS notifications filtered by severity.

items.title: Sequences, recipes, batches
items.description: Step programs with transition conditions, recipes with variables, and batches that move through production lines with a full stage history.

items.title: Trends and history
items.description: Every signal is archived. Compare parameters on one chart, zoom into a shift, save sensor groups and export to Excel.

items.title: From SCADA to PLC code
items.description: Generate a Siemens SCL program and TIA Portal tag tables from the configured project instead of entering the same data twice.

items.title: Project in minutes
items.description: A setup wizard creates PLCs, devices, areas, programs and diagrams in one pass. Custom device classes become reusable templates.

items.title: Made for the shop floor
items.description: Kiosk mode for operator panels, an on-screen keyboard with 10 layouts, 11 interface languages including Arabic, and built-in guided tours.

items.title: Access control and audit
items.description: Roles with per-section permissions. Every operator action is logged: who changed what, when and from which address.

screens.intro: Real screens of OBJECTSCADA 5.0 with a demo pasteurization project. The interface switches between light and dark theme together with this page.
screens.note: OBJECTSCADA 5.0 · demo project · click the image to open it full size

items.title: Dashboard
items.description: System status, production areas with start/stop controls, recent alarms, live trends and the state of every device on one screen.

items.title: Mimic diagram
items.description: The process as the operator sees it: pumps, valves, pipes and live values. Devices are controlled straight from the diagram.

items.title: Diagram editor
items.description: The same diagram in edit mode: a toolbox with devices, pipes, production lines, recipe variables, images and charts.

items.title: Alarms and events
items.description: Alarm log with severity, status and acknowledgement. Filter by priority, device and time; resolve alarms in bulk.

items.title: Trends
items.description: Temperature history of several sensors on one chart over the selected period, with zoom, sensor groups and export.

items.title: Devices
items.description: All plant devices with type, connection status and the programs and conditions where each device is used.

items.title: Activity log
items.description: Audit trail of operator actions: logins, starts and stops, setpoint changes and project edits.

protocols.h2: Works with the controllers you already have
protocols.intro: Drivers for the main industrial protocols are included. Connect existing equipment without changing the PLC program.

items.name: Siemens S7
items.detail: S7-300, S7-400, S7-1200 and S7-1500 over Ethernet: data blocks, markers, inputs and outputs.

items.name: Modbus TCP
items.detail: Holding and input registers, coils and discrete inputs. Modbus RTU devices through a TCP gateway.

items.name: OPC UA
items.detail: Client connection to any OPC UA server.

items.name: MQTT
items.detail: Publish and subscribe for IoT devices, sensors and gateways.

plc.title: PLC code generated from the SCADA project
plc.body: Devices, interlocks, sequences, recipes and alarms configured in OBJECTSCADA become a ready-to-import Siemens program. The SCADA and the controller are built from one source.
points: SCL source and TIA Portal tag tables for S7-1200 and S7-1500
Device-level logic for S7-300 and S7-400 (STEP 7 Classic)
Rack and PROFINET configurator with GSD import and address table
Logic runs on the server or is handed over to the PLC

deployment.h2: From a pilot to a running plant
deployment.intro: OBJECTSCADA runs on your hardware inside the plant network. Nothing depends on a cloud service or an internet connection.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We review your equipment, PLCs and protocols and agree on the scope of a pilot.

steps.title: Installation
steps.description: A bootable installer turns an industrial PC into a SCADA server and an operator panel — fully offline.

steps.title: Project setup
steps.description: The wizard creates PLCs, devices, areas and diagrams; the team then refines the mimics in the editor.

steps.title: Operation
steps.description: Updates online or from a file with automatic backup and rollback. Several plant servers are managed from one master.

comparison.h2: How it differs from a classic SCADA
comparison.intro: The practical differences that matter in day-to-day operation and in the cost of a project.

rows.classic: A client application installed and licensed on every workstation.
rows.ours: A browser on any PC, panel or tablet in the network.

rows.classic: Price grows with the number of tags and clients.
rows.ours: No limits on tags or clients. Time-based or perpetual licence, free trial.

rows.classic: SCADA tags and PLC code are maintained separately.
rows.ours: Siemens code and tag tables are generated from the SCADA project.

rows.classic: Operating system, database and runtime are set up one by one.
rows.ours: One offline installer: server and operator kiosk on the same PC.
Online or offline update with automatic backup and rollback.
